(30 min, all 4 of us!!)"},{"spec_id":"spec_0543","text":"STONEWOOD HISTORY MUSEUM
Training Walkthrough: CMS Record Migration - the Jasper initiative
Organizer: Ivan (Collections Information Systems)
Duration: 60 min | Attendees: 16 (Collections, Registration, Digital, Conservation)
Location: Education Room 2 / screen share

AGENDA

1. Context (Ivan, 5 min)
Overview of the Jasper initiative phase 2: migration of legacy accession records into the new collections management system, aligned with the updated data dictionary and controlled vocabularies.

2. Object record field mapping (Victor Carvalho, 10 min)
How legacy fields map to the new schema: accession number, object name (AAT-aligned), provenance notes, dimensions, and current location. Victor will screen-share the mapping spreadsheet already in the shared drive.

3. Media asset linking and DAMS sync (Raj Fitzgerald, 10 min)
Naming conventions for derivative files, IIIF manifest generation, and rights statement fields.

4. Loans and condition reporting module (Priya Ostrowski, 10 min)
Where incoming and outgoing loan records, condition reports and facility reports now live. No workflow changes, only new menu locations.

5. Location and movement control (Aisha Brennan, 10 min)
Barcode scan steps for object movements between storage, galleries and conservation lab.

6. Authority records and name/term lists (Soren Ilunga, 10 min)
Read-only for most users; requests for new terms go through the existing form.

7. Wrap-up (Beth Oyelaran, 5 min)
Link to recorded walkthrough, quick-reference PDF and sandbox credentials.

Note: All sections are demonstrations of finalized configuration.
